currentRoundInspection.placement: The inspected aerial picture confirms the separate palace/gabled donjon, open trapezoidal forecourt, three cone-capped corners, entrance tower and long casemate. Standard viewer PMTiles and the retained palace/courtyard outline establish approximate island location and forecourt approach sign. The mapped relation covers the palace only; whole-compound alignment remains an exterior estimate. A reconstructed1.3m working court clears the coarse island ground and bounded foundations extend beneath samples; short connecting bridge retained at its inferred level. Anchor 24.934056788,54.652709433; heading -1.112277445339; standard PMTiles datum 145.11330053210258m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground.
